description: Use when an agent needs the key facts of a document, not just its text: Korean HWP/HWPX, PDF, DOCX or web page. Input: url via GET, or POST a file (multipart 'file', raw body, or JSON contentBase64+filename). Output: fixed-schema JSON title, title_en, document_type, date, org, amounts, tables (parsed rows), english_overview. Bad input or model outage refused before payment. Example: ?url=https://example.com/ Price: $0.009 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

type.description: Optional expected type; a mismatch is rejected before payment (415, not charged)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PDF, DOCX, HWP, HWPX or web page. For uploads use POST.

name: docs_extract
title: Document extract: PDF, DOCX, HWP/HWPX or web page to structured JSON with English overview
